about_the_game:
A new approach to representing Athletics and Track mechanics in gameplay.

Compete against other sprinters in different modes and tournaments to fill your trophy cabinet and unlock new gear .

Multiple modes are available to the player:

•

A new Training ground mode help new comers

•

A Time Trial Mode to challenge players and unlock reward

•

Quick races can be done in single player or with local 2 player

•

Hermes Quest:

Participate at this new original tournament with a created sprinter and strive for Gold.

•

Multiple Locations, both indoors and outdoors.

•

Multiple Race Types ranging from the 60 meters to the 400 meters
